body:
﻿## Reproduction

In the real ObliqueWorldScene with built square walls and Blender PNG frames, place an actor at tile (3.5, 5.5) behind the kitchen's full rear wall. At yaw 45°, elevation 45°, 1920×1080, its orange head and torso paint over the wall. An actor in front at (10, 8) displays normally.

Evidence: [Full HD screenshot](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/00ff7f79cf/docs/research/2026-10-01-oblique-actor-depth/actor-behind-full-wall-yaw45-elev45.png) and [repro harness](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/00ff7f79cf/tests/browser/oblique-actor-depth-probe.spec.ts).

Run the focused browser probe against `tests/browser/oblique-preset-art-qa.html?preset=kitchen-basic&actorDepth=1`.

## Cause

`actorGraphics` uses Phaser depth 3; textured solid images use 2..2.9. The projector sorts actors and solids together, but those display depths override the intended interleaving.

## Acceptance

At multiple camera yaws, actors behind full walls are occluded by the wall, actors in front remain visible, and Save/Load still restores the same visual ordering. Keep cutaway walls and fixture images ordered by their projected depth, with no actor Graphics pool permanently above every solid.
title: Oblique view paints actors through full square walls
